welcome_subtitle: Your internal employee hub for hotel operations, HR services, SOPs, department workflows, and team collaboration.
sign_in_subtitle: Sign in with your ALTUS staff credentials to access your portal.

forgot_password.title: Forgot Password
forgot_password.description: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot_password.success_message: We've sent a password reset link to your email address. Please check your inbox and follow the instructions.
forgot_password.check_spam: Didn't receive the email? Check your spam folder.
forgot_password.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
forgot_password.error: Failed to send reset email. Please try again.

reset_password.title: Set New Password
reset_password.description: Please enter your new password below.
reset_password.success_message: Your password has been successfully updated. You will be redirected to login.
reset_password.invalid_message: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset_password.confirm_message: Click the button below to continue with your password reset.
reset_password.resend_success: A new reset link has been sent to your email. Please check your inbox.
reset_password.resend_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

session_timeout.title: Session Expiring Soon
session_timeout.message: Your session will expire due to inactivity. Would you like to stay logged in?
session_timeout.expired_message: Your session has expired due to inactivity. Please sign in again to continue.

errors.title: Authentication Failed
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password you entered is incorrect. Please check and try again.
errors.network_error: Network connection error. Please check your connection and try again later.
errors.missing_fields: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.rate_limit: Too many login attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.
errors.account_disabled: Your account has been disabled. Please contact your system administrator.
errors.account_locked: Your account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. Reset your password to unlock your account immediately.
errors.account_locked_expired: Your account was locked but the lockout period has ended. Please try signing in again.
errors.captcha_required: Please complete the security check to continue.

account_locked.title: Account Locked
account_locked.description: Your account has been temporarily locked for security reasons.
account_locked.unlock_via_reset: You can unlock your account immediately by resetting your password.
account_locked.contact_admin: Or contact your system administrator for assistance.

security.remaining_attempts: {{count}} login attempt remaining before temporary lockout.
security.remaining_attempts_other: {{count}} login attempts remaining before temporary lockout.

security_tips.title: Security Tips
security_tips.never_share: Never share your password with anyone
